promptLatex: A fair six-sided die is rolled twice. Given that the sum of the two rolls is even, what is the probability that the two rolls show the same number?
hintLatex: An even sum means the two rolls have the same parity, and that restricts the sample space.
There are $18$ ordered pairs with an even sum, $9$ of them even-even and $9$ odd-odd.
Of those $18$ pairs, $6$ show the same number on both rolls.
